raw_glosses: An intermediate floor or storey in between the main floors of a building; specifically, one that is directly above the ground floor which does not extend over the whole floorspace of the building, and so resembles a large balcony overlooking the ground floor; an entresol.
glosses: An intermediate floor or storey in between the main floors of a building; specifically, one that is directly above the ground floor which does not extend over the whole floorspace of the building, and so resembles a large balcony overlooking the ground floor; an entresol.

raw_glosses: (by extension) An apartment, room, etc., on such an intermediate floor.
glosses: An apartment, room, etc., on such an intermediate floor.

raw_glosses: (Canada, US) The lowest balcony in an auditorium, cinema, theatre, etc.; the dress circle.
glosses: The lowest balcony in an auditorium, cinema, theatre, etc.; the dress circle.

raw_glosses: Additional flooring laid over a floor to bring it up to some height or level.
glosses: Additional flooring laid over a floor to bring it up to some height or level.

raw_glosses: In full mezzanine window: a small window at the height of a mezzanine floor (sense 1.1) or an attic, used to light these floors.
glosses: In full mezzanine window: a small window at the height of a mezzanine floor (sense 1.1) or an attic, used to light these floors.

raw_glosses: (theater, obsolete) A floor under the stage, from which contrivances such as traps are worked.
glosses: A floor under the stage, from which contrivances such as traps are worked.
